intent: Independently validate the frozen Longcycle Architecture Baseline v1.0.0 and the preserved Longcycle development operating system with a genuinely fresh Agent. This is a continuity/governance acceptance step only: do not open new research, product or architecture work; do not create or replace semantic owners; do not modify Baseline semantics. The subject must recover the terminal mission, long-term direction, medium-term goal, short-term milestone and current atomic task; preserve Memory-first/Evidence-final historical recovery, PIT/no-lookahead, Reality/Judgment/Outcome separation, Capability Registry ownership, Repair Memory, bounded on-demand history recall, Vertical Alignment and independent judgment; and demonstrate correct L1/L2/L3/L4 reasoning under external cues.
rationale_summary: Architecture Baseline v1.0.0 has been merged to main and the accepted main merge head passed both longcycle/full-ci and longcycle/architecture-baseline. The remaining acceptance risk is continuity drift: whether a zero-context Agent reconstructs the old Longcycle worldview, five-level strategic hierarchy, anti-tunnel discipline and architecture-change burden of proof without old chat context. This step therefore reuses the existing continuity and governance owners and permits only a report-only external drill plus maintainer review.
